_about: Render recipes for krew-render. Copy to $KREW_HOME/recipes.json (or set render.recipes). One entry per ComfyUI API-format workflow in render.workflows_dir. prompt_node / image_node / size_nodes are node ids in that workflow. license is what the model's licence says; render cards read 'apache', 'mit' or 'open' as commercial-ok and 'non-commercial', 'research', 'community', 'internal' or 'cloud' as not.

recipes.purpose: edit a still you already have
